title: China Stockpiled Oil, and Now It Could Dominate the Energy Landscape
description: The war with Iran revealed just how much influence the world’s biggest oil importer has over prices and other countries’ supplies of jet fuel, gasoline and diesel.
author: Rebecca F. Elliott and Keith Bradsher

title: Trump Air Force One Photos Fuel Kennedy Center Demolition Speculation
description: Images captured through the windows of Air Force One showed President Trump reviewing a poster with the title “Kennedy Center DEMOLISHED.”
author: Shawn McCreesh

title: The Face of London in the 1960s Is Living Her Best Life
description: The face of London in the 1960s is living her best life at the age of 77.
author: Rhonda Garelick

title: The $15,000 Settlement That Destroyed My Father’s Life
description: A 35-foot fall didn’t kill Michael Wagner. The nearly 18-year failure of the safety net did. Before he died, he recorded 694 videos explaining how.
author: Brittany Wagner and Alexander Stockton

title: Jewish Leaders in Michigan Urge Support for El-Sayed’s Senate Bid
description: The public petition comes after other Michigan Jews registered their discontent with Abdul El-Sayed, the state’s Democratic Senate nominee.
author: Bayliss Wagner

title: Who Will Win the Midterms? Republicans Are Reeling.
description: The party is putting up a costly defense of states and districts that President Trump won easily in 2024. And in places like Georgia, strategists wonder if it’s too late.
author: Reid J. Epstein and Shane Goldmacher

title: Trump Sanctions on Cuba Strands Thousands Of Shipping Containers
description: The U.S. says its sanctions are not aimed at depriving Cuba of essential goods. Thousands of stranded shipping containers tell a different story.
author: Ed Augustin and Frances Robles

title: Trump’s Minnesota Surge Threatened Democracy, Judge Warns
description: In a rare interview, Patrick Schiltz, who served as the federal court’s chief judge last winter, called the administration’s actions “a grave threat to the rule of law.”
author: Mattathias Schwartz

title: How Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s Writings Help Explain A.I. Fears
description: The collected essays of Dario Amodei help explain why some people are so worried about artificial intelligence.
author: David Streitfeld

title: The Hidden Human Cost of Kim Jong-un’s New Power
description: The North Korean leader’s financial and diplomatic leverage rests on the brutal exploitation of his own people, from coal miners to diplomats, at home and abroad.
author: Choe Sang-Hun

title: Trump Wanted Canada as the 51st State. He Ended Up Pushing It Toward the European Union.
description: The invitation by the E.U. for Canada to become an “associate member” is a sign of Mr. Trump’s brand of diplomacy, which often involves threatening America’s closest friends.
author: Luke Broadwater and Michael Crowley

title: OpenAI Discloses Six New Incidents of ‘Concerning' A.I. Behavior
description: The artificial intelligence company also released a framework for reporting when its systems go wrong.
author: Emmy Martin

title: Park Service Steamrolls Through Review of Trump’s Arch
description: Despite objections from preservationists, final approval for the 250-foot-tall monument appears on track for November.
author: Emily Badger

title: Covid Vaccines Delayed for Half of U.S. Children
description: The Health Department has not decided whether to provide the shots to states through the Vaccines for Children program, which serves uninsured and low-income families.
author: Maggie Astor

title: Annie Dillard, Meditative Author of ‘Pilgrim at Tinker Creek,’ Dies at 81
description: Her Thoreau-like account of journeys in the woods, published when she was 28, was the first of many ruminations on life and nature, good and evil.
author: Daniel Lewis

title: Microscopic Videos That Show the Invisible Wonders Around Us
description: The winners of this year’s Nikon Small World in Motion competition showcase the wiggly, feathery, undulating beauty of invisible life.
author: Stella Raine Chu

title: The World Economy Is Becoming Wary of the U.S.
description: America’s position of global economic stability is starting to look shakier as the Trump administration piles on debt and doubles down on sanctions.
author: Alan Rappeport

title: Billions in Taxes Go Unpaid. Under Trump, the I.R.S. Won’t Say How Much.
description: The absence of the annual estimate on the tax gap could make it more difficult to assess whether more taxes are going unpaid since President Trump took office.
author: Andrew Duehren

title: Unstitching the 1,000-Year-Old Story of the Bayeux Tapestry
description: The medieval masterpiece has traveled from France to England for a once-in-a-lifetime show. It is not what our critic Jason Farago expected.
author: Jason Farago
